0022600157.text: The Toronto Raptors (3-2) are coming off a loss and sit 3rd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, and 4th in the East. The Los Angeles Lakers (4-1) are on a one-game winning streak, lead the Pacific and are 3rd in the West, and they have one more game to play before this one. Kawhi Leonard and Nate Bittle are out for Toronto and Adou Thiero and Ziaire Williams are out for Los Angeles, and the teams have not met yet in 2026-27, after the Raptors lost 0-2 in 2025-26 and most recently fell 110-93 in Los Angeles on January 18, 2026.
